FN-EXZDC9C-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 161
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator William Beasley
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/05/2024
Senate Bill 161 as introduced would authorize county sheriff’s to conduct fundraising events
and use the proceeds and profits from the events for lawful purposes relating to the operation of
the office. This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
